ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has an input terminal on the left, and the upper line is labeled with the total current I flowing in; three vertical branches are connected in parallel between the upper and lower buses. The left branch is a resistor branch, and its current is labeled I1; the middle branch is an inductor branch, and its current is labeled I2; the right branch is a capacitor branch, and its current is labeled I3. Reasoning: In a parallel AC circuit, take the voltage as the phasor reference. The resistor-branch current I1 is in phase with the voltage and serves as the real-axis component, which is 3 A. The directions of the inductor-branch current and the capacitor-branch current are opposite on the reactive axis, so the magnitude of the net reactive current is I2 - I3 = 8 - 4 = 4 A. The magnitude of the main-line current I is the phasor composition of the real-axis component and the net reactive component: I = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5 A.

method.method_draft: After identifying the branches from the image, choose the common voltage waveform as the reference. From the text, assign i_R = 3 sin(ωt), i_L = 8 sin(ωt - 90°), and i_C = 4 sin(ωt + 90°). Add instantaneous currents: i = 3 sin(ωt) + 8 sin(ωt - 90°) + 4 sin(ωt + 90°), which simplifies to 3 sin(ωt) - 4 cos(ωt). The amplitude of the total source current is sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5 A, so I = 5 A.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个并联电路，左侧为电源端，电源电流 I 从上方导线进入。上、下两条母线之间有三条竖直支路：左支路是电阻，标注电流 i1；中支路是电感，标注电流 i2；右支路是电容，标注电流 i3。三个支路电流箭头均向下，说明它们并联在同一电压两端。推理：按指定方法，以公共电压波形为参考。电阻支路电流与电压同相，取 i_R = 3 sin(ωt)。电感支路电流滞后电压 90°，取 i_L = 8 sin(ωt - 90°)。电容支路电流超前电压 90°，取 i_C = 4 sin(ωt + 90°)。总电流瞬时表达式为 i = 3 sin(ωt) + 8 sin(ωt - 90°) + 4 sin(ωt + 90°)。利用 sin(ωt - 90°) = -cos(ωt)，sin(ωt + 90°) = cos(ωt)，得 i = 3 sin(ωt) - 8 cos(ωt) + 4 cos(ωt) = 3 sin(ωt) - 4 cos(ωt)。因此总电流幅值为 sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5 A，所以 I = 5 A。
